## Review trigger

- File/path/PR/issue involved:
- Why might this be unsafe or outside authority?
- Is this patient, client, unpublished, credential, private repository, or restricted research material?

## Required action

- Remove / redact / hold / clarify authority / other:
- Urgency:
- Who can decide?

## Fail-closed state

- [ ] Material is not published.
- [ ] Generated outputs have not been refreshed with unsafe material.
- [ ] Publication is blocked until authority is confirmed.

## Notes

- Relevant public-safe context:
